introduction.en: The Global Foreign Exchange Committee (GFXC) is an international body established to maintain and update the FX Global Code, a set of voluntary principles for the wholesale foreign exchange market.
introduction.hi: The Global Foreign Exchange Committee (GFXC) is an international body established to maintain and update the FX Global Code, a set of voluntary principles for the wholesale foreign exchange market.

body.en: The GFXC promotes integrity by setting standards for ethics, information sharing, and risk management. For India, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has actively encouraged market participants to adopt the Code. This enhances the credibility of the Indian forex market, attracts foreign institutional investment, and aligns domestic practices with global benchmarks, thereby reducing systemic risks.

conclusion.en: While voluntary, the FX Global Code serves as a crucial framework for fostering trust and efficiency in the increasingly complex global financial landscape.

valueAddition.en: The FX Global Code was developed in 2017 to address concerns regarding market manipulation and lack of transparency.
